assets.prompt: Recreate as an ORIGINAL fintech campaign web banner, distinct from any hero cover: wide banner layout on a deep navy background. Left: small logo 'Lumo' top-left, two-line white headline 'Your money, one tap away' with 'one tap' in teal, short subline 'Send, save and track spending in real time.', a teal pill button 'Open an account'. Right: a large modern smartphone mockup showing a clean banking app dashboard (balance $12,480, spending chart, recent transactions), beside it a contactless payment card in teal-violet gradient, subtle glowing data lines. No people, no office scene. English only, every word spelled exactly, crisp type, no other brands, no watermark.
